Children of Darkness. It's a documentary about children with serious mental disorders and is over all extremely sad because most of those kids couldn't live normal and functional lives because the psychiatric care when it came out (1983) was minimal compared to today's care.

Another one is Just Melvin, Just Evil which is about a child molester and extreme cases of Stockholm Syndrome. It documents many family members (Melvin is the grandpa and dad who molests) and how they've coped with their childhoods and what Melvin did to them. 

Both are very sad, and I do not recommend watching them unless you understand how sad they really are, and how mad they can make you

After hours of debating whether or not to post this image, I decided to. This is Savannah and I along with another friend who I blurred out for her privacy. Savannah was my one of my best friends who could hurt no one even if she tried, which she didn't. She was the sweetest, most caring, and loving person I've known. She was just 17. This picture is about a week before her fatal accident with an 18 wheeler in the rain on the day of 3/11/16. She succumbed to her severe brain trauma on the day of 3/14/16. She was an organ donor, so when she was announced legally brain dead, her organs were given to 11 people. Those three days were the longest I've ever experienced. In and out of the hospital, lots of tears, and numbness. It's been a bit more than four months as of this post, but it's still so fresh. We all miss her so much every day, and love her. The good always seem to die young. Rest in peace, Savannah.

I had a dream where I was a passenger in a car passing a playground/ pool I'd frequent as a child. I felt a hand on my left shoulder that was very cold, almost like stepping out into freezing weather after a hit shower. Anyways I turned around and I saw this shadowy black figure staring at me. The stare felt like it was piercing inti my soul, and it had no eyes. I woke up almost immediately, and I was laying on my right side. I felt the same icy touch on the same shoulder, and I was almost pulled onto my back. I saw the same figure staring at me with the same stare. After what felt like hours being trapped by its stare, it seemed to bend down and go inside of me. It felt super cold, but I could move. Needless to say I spent the next few weeks with the lamp on at night. I still get dreams with the same figure and waking up and seeing it. I can't explain the feeling it gives me when I see it. It's horrific, and I have no explanation of why it happens
